notes: Own witness from the read lineage-reads-1985/g-03.json: the reader showed the compiler correct at 85 with a case of the suite (conformance:cases/12.3.7-SPECIAL-NAMES/l1c01_native_ordinal_positions), joined as the row's own test. The read: "The implementor-defined character set associated with the computer specified in the OBJECT-COMPUTER paragraph". GR-12.3.7.4-6 (with l1c01 at 85) states only that the implementor orders the native set, not its tie to the object computer, and the other candidates are ALPHABET/CLASS clause rules; so no pointer carries the whole scope. Code location located after the read: StorageByte maps the native character set to its storage bytes and NativeCollatingSequence fixes its high and low characters.
